fix.finding: A concurrent close between pending-ACK registration and select/send can close the socket, making select raise ValueError and escaping the transport failure path.
fix.change: Normalize ValueError alongside OSError around _send_until as BridgeDisconnected. TaskMailbox's existing delivery failure path records BridgeDisconnected as a durable UNKNOWN and prevents replay; pending ACK cleanup remains in request finally.
fix.behavioral_scope: Only G3BridgeServer.request send-boundary error normalization changed; no test, schema, extension, or other product file was edited.
